decision.summary: The client tests log averaged Navigation Timing values without a threshold or comparative baseline. Their telemetry form retires into the smaller merchant-facing native readiness contract; quantitative performance benchmarking remains outside migration scope until it has an owner, controlled environment, budget, and actionable thresholds.

verification.summary: Passed 1/1 in 8.014 seconds with zero retries. On one populated native Blocks checkout, Card remained visible, enabled, selectable, and backed by exactly one visible and named Payment Element; persisted WooPay enablement produced one visible, enabled, accessibly named WooPay express action without displacing Card. Cart, product, and setting were restored, and no order or provider request was made.
